gatoh.graphs.Graph.generate_graph

Graph.generate_graph(agents: list[Agent], method: str = '', relationship_range: tuple[float, float] = (-1.0, 1.0), ensure_complete: bool = True) → Self[source]

Randomly generate edges between existing Graph nodes and add them to the graph.

Parameters:

  • agents (list[Agent]) – The subset of Agents in the base model that are being used as the nodes for this graph.

  • method (str, optional) – The random generation method to use. Possible choices include: ‘small-world’, ‘scale-free’, ‘random’, ‘blockmodel’; Defaults to ‘small-world’.

  • relationship_range (tuple[float, float], optional) – The valid range of generated relationship strengths (at most, constrained to [-1.0, 1.0]).

  • ensure_complete (bool, optional) – A flag indicating if the generated graph should be complete or not (in the case of ‘small-world’).

Raises:

  • ValueError – If no agents are being passed to this function.

  • ValueError – If an invalid random generation method is being passed to this function.

Returns:

A reference to this Graph object.

Return type:

Graph
